intro: Practice: a new case with the same skills. Saffron Pharma Distributors, a medicine wholesaler in Ahmedabad, on Tuesday 10 November 2026. A fake courier email, a script in a zip file, and files locked on the share. Fewer hints than the walkthrough: use what you learned there. All times are UTC unless a question says IST.
handin: A triage note for AL-3303, an escalation, and a shift handover for the Saffron case (download each from the report builder, or hand in this notebook).
intro_same: Practice: the same Kestrel Logistics case, with fewer hints and harder questions. Each answer needs two facts put together, or a time worked out. Every time in the evidence is UTC unless a question says IST.

ask: How many minutes after the ticket was opened did the helpdesk pull the cable? (a number)
